description: This file defines Express.js routes for managing LLM cost records, including CRUD operations with tenant enforcement, Swagger API documentation, and middleware for authentication and tenant scoping.

methods.name: router.use
methods.description: Sets up middleware for authentication, tenant enforcement, and tenant scope validation.

methods.name: router.get
methods.description: Defines GET endpoints for listing all cost records and retrieving a record by ID.

methods.name: router.post
methods.description: Defines POST endpoint for creating a new cost record.

methods.name: router.put
methods.description: Defines PUT endpoint for updating a cost record by ID.

methods.name: router.delete
methods.description: Defines DELETE endpoint for removing a cost record by ID.
